observations: Beige/white photocopier wrapped tightly in plastic film, appears boxed/palletized for shipment or storage.
Photo 0 shows brand and model printed on front panel: 'SHARP AR-M207'.
Photo 1 shows a 'digital' logo badge and paper size indicators (A4, A3) on the side panel, consistent with a digital multifunction copier.
Photo 2 is a near-duplicate angle of photo 0, also showing the 'SHARP AR-M207' label under plastic wrap.
No power cable, control panel, display, or toner compartment clearly visible; unit is not shown powered on.
Watermark 'SMATECH MEGA EQUIPMENT' overlaid on all photos, seller's business branding, not proof of item condition.

claims.evidence: No shipping label, import document, or usage log visible in any photo.

claims.claim: Packed with an extensive range of superb performance functions
claims.evidence: Generic marketing text, not tied to any visible feature or test in photos.

risks.risk: Unit may not power on or may have internal fault (common for used copiers shipped from abroad).
risks.proof: Video clip of unit powered on, showing control panel lighting up and a test print/copy.

risks.risk: Drum, toner, and fuser unit condition unknown; these are costly consumables.
risks.proof: Photo of open toner/drum compartment showing consumable levels and part condition.
risks.if_unproven: priced as needing full consumable replacement

risks.risk: Physical damage (cracks, dents, broken trays) could be hidden under the plastic wrap.
risks.proof: Photos with wrap fully removed, all sides and corners visible.
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetically unverified, assume moderate wear

risks.risk: Missing accessories such as power cable, paper trays, or drum unit.
risks.proof: Photo of all included accessories laid out next to the unit.
risks.if_unproven: priced as base unit only, no accessories

risks.risk: Page/copy counter unknown, affecting remaining service life.
risks.proof: Photo or screenshot of the internal page counter from the control panel menu.
risks.if_unproven: priced as high page count / near end of life

proof_requests: Video of the unit powered on with a live test copy or print.
Photos with all plastic wrap removed, all four sides and the top glass visible.
Photo of the open toner/drum compartment showing consumable condition.
Photo or screenshot of the internal page/copy counter.
Photo of all accessories included (power cable, trays, manual).
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a Sharp AR-M207 photocopier from the visible label, but it is shown only wrapped and unpowered with no functional test, so it must be priced at worst case as an unverified, possibly non-working unit pending proof.
